description: AI news digest Sep 21: Qwen-Image-2.1 7B, Jev plus open Kev decision models, Atria Dawn MIT agent, Paper2Agent, virtual biotech, ScientistTwo.
lead: Small models doing bigger jobs, agents that turn papers into tools, and a hard lesson in reading AI evaluations. A 7B image model unifies generation and editing with native transparency, decision-only models trade prose for sub-second judgments, an MIT-licensed agentic giant bakes planning into weights, Stanford ships both paper-agents and a 37,000-agent virtual biotech, and a careful reread of Google's ScientistTwo shows why held-out reviewers matter. Every summary is in our own words; follow the links for the original reporting.
title: AI news digest — September 21, 2026: compact builders, paper agents, judge the judges
